The system will generate an Application Number. - Click Print Application.

children.text: The applicant must be a woman.
The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
The applicant must be residing in a tribal area.
The applicant must be engaged in or willing to establish a self-employment venture through a Nahri Kendra.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: - The applicant must be a woman. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. - The applicant must be residing in a tribal area. - The applicant must be engaged in or willing to establish a self-employment venture through a Nahri Kendra.

children.text: Monetary Benefit
50% of the project cost or ₹5,00,000, whichever is less, provided as subsidy.
The remaining 50% of the project cost is provided as a loan.
Subsidy Disbursement
Given in two installments – 60% in the first installment and 40% in the second installment.
Interest Rate
Loan at 4% per annum.
Repayment
Loan (excluding subsidy) must be repaid in 20 equal installments over 5 years, including interest.
Option to repay earlier is allowed.
Beneficiary Contribution
No upfront contribution required from the beneficiary.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme empowers tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project cost.

children.text: The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Under this scheme, tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project costs and the remaining 50% as a loan at a concessional interest rate.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The "Mukhyamantri Nahri Kendra" was launched by the Tribal Development Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme aims to empower tribal women by providing them with livelihood opportunities through women-run centers. These centers promote the sale of tribal dishes and home-made products, thereby improving income and living standards. Under this scheme, tribal women-run groups receive a subsidy covering 50% of project costs and the remaining 50% as a loan at a concessional interest rate.
